data.name: Surya
data.gender_notes: Surya is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sūrya, 'sun', from the root svar, 'to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit sūrya (सूर्य). Surya, the Vedic sun god. Surya is a Sanskrit name meaning “The sun”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Surya expresses “The sun”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit sūrya, 'sun', from the root svar, 'to shine'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Surya total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

in_english.name: Surya
in_english.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sūrya, 'sun', from the root svar, 'to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit sūrya (सूर्य). Surya, the Vedic sun god. Surya is a Sanskrit name meaning “The sun”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Surya is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “The sun”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Surya is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “The sun” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Surya; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: Surya is the sun deity in Hinduism and is one of the most important gods in the Vedic pantheon. He is the source of all energy and life, and is often depicted riding his chariot across the sky.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Surya.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
